testcase.name: a generated name cannot escape the photo directory
there is no comparison to make from a single day
files nothing points at are found so they can be cleaned up
rows whose file is gone are reported rather than deleted
a name read back from the database is validated, not trusted
the extension comes from an allowlist
a uuid survives intact, because that is the normal case
a name is still produced when the token has nothing usable in it
the comparison spans the whole history, not the last two
